# Platforms and payments

One page per platform and payment provider, made from the same lists as the setup pages, so the two always agree.

| Page | How it is turned on | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| [Twitch](twitch.md) | choose on the Modules page | Twitch chat in site chat, the Twitch player, and Twitch sign-in for your viewers. |
| [Kick](kick.md) | choose on the Modules page | Kick chat in site chat, live detection, and Kick sign-in for your viewers. |
| [Streamplace](streamplace.md) | choose on the Modules page | The stream.place player and its chat. Nothing to register: this site is its own app there. |
| [Ko-fi, Patreon and Streamlabs](donations.md) | choose on the Modules page | Tips and memberships through outside services, shown as alerts and counted on the support bar. They make nobody a supporter here: the site's supporter perks come from a Stripe subscription or a gift sub. |
| [OBS control](obs.md) | module (switch) | One browser source in OBS — the rig page — plays the bot's voice and the sound alerts into your stream, draws the bot's avatar, switches scenes on request and pauses the timer on a scene. It connects out from OBS, so it works from any network. Off: the rig page is refused and nothing reaches OBS. |
| [YouTube](youtube.md) | module (switch) | Reads the chat of your YouTube live streams into site chat. Off: nothing is read from YouTube and no YouTube setup page is shown. |
| [Card payments (Stripe)](stripe.md) | module (switch) | Card payments with your own Stripe account: subscriptions, gift subs, tips and points. You are the merchant; the money goes to your Stripe balance. Off: no card checkout, and Stripe's webhook address answers "not found", so Stripe keeps its events and retries them for about three days. |
| [PayPal and Venmo](paypal.md) | module (switch) | Tips and points purchases through your own PayPal Business account, with Venmo when PayPal offers it. One-time payments only: subscriptions and gifts are card payments (Stripe). Off: no PayPal button, and PayPal's webhook address answers "not found", so PayPal keeps its events and retries them for about three days. |
